datePolicy: All cited external URLs retain explicit original source access dates of 2026-11-05; this localization did not externally refresh them. Access does not mean price publication or guaranteed future availability. Original verification is not fresh verification.
uncertainties: Planning information only, not financial or mortgage advice. Personal net income, debts, dependants, age, credit, SDLT residency/ownership and individual lender eligibility are unverified.

A first Lifetime ISA payment on 2026-11-05 cannot satisfy the twelve-month condition for September 2027 completion; earliest date 2027-11-05. Existing eligibility and withdrawals need checking; bonuses excluded.

Area figures are provisional August 2026 mixed-property district transaction averages released 2026-10-21, not two-bedroom prices, live listings or future forecasts. No property-specific condition, safety, tenure or transport evidence was collected.

Fees, reserve, ownership extras and stress rate are estimates/placeholders. Dated mortgage products and tax rules are not 2027 guarantees; actual service charges, major works, repairs, rent overlap and surcharges may increase costs.

Transaction timeline is a backwards planning judgment; a collapse or remediation can exceed September. The old process guide is not used for current schemes/reform implementation. Original workbook verification is reported, not repeated.
editingContract: Readable English and Simplified Chinese corresponding lines and table cells retain complete numeric, currency, date and URL parity. Local draft only; no stars or review markup.

audience.en: Working first-time-buyer couple in Greater Manchester earning £72,000 gross a year with £38,000 saved, hoping to complete by September 2027.
